entries.error: function claim_search(unknown, unknown) does not exist
entries.why: THE BIG ONE. claim_search does not exist in the real schema and cannot be ported: the stub retrieves on evidence.claim.domain_table, .text, .search_tsv and .embedding, none of which exist there. Real retrieval is chunk-grained in evidence.retrieval_chunk, so this is a change of grain rather than a rename — claims are the citable unit, chunks the retrievable one. Getting the resolution wrong is a §3.9.2 fabrication-class bug, which is why it needs a decision before code.

entries.why: side_effect_job is a stub invention. The real schema has obs.review_queue_item, which is strictly better — FKs to principal.clinician and safety.clinical_domain, a c_no_implicit_approval CHECK, and a trigger enforcing §2.3.4c (a clinician may not claim a review outside their registered domain). The stub replaced a safety control with a generic queue that enforces none of it. Fixing this is a reroute, not a new table.
